scope.description: Whole infozip application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: ZIP creation/update/extraction, compression, member selection, directory metadata, archive maintenance and compatibility.

coverage.rationale: A portable publication bundle is useful, but compression, extraction, updates, directories and most archive management are not supported.

scope.description: Selected publication files to a flat deterministic stored ZIP with an unsigned inventory.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Named publication membership and a portable inventory hide ZIP details; the operation remains a thin packaging workflow.

limitations: One to sixteen flat stored files; no compression, ZIP64, encryption, directories or source metadata preservation; inventory is unsigned.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
